          About this item

          • AirTag Stick-On Case: This two-piece stick-on AirTag case is compact and professionally designed to securely hold your AirTag in place; The notches on this holder help amplify the AirTag's sound when trying to locate your belongings
          • AirTag Keychain Case: This AirTag case features precise cut-outs, a seamless fit, and a front-open design to display personalized engravings on your AirTag; It also offers a flexible enclosure that ensures a snug fit without compromising functionality
          • Premium-Quality Materials: Both AirTag holders are made of high-quality materials to make them rugged, lightweight, scratch-resistant, shockproof, and durable; These features ensure the protection of your device from bumps, drops, and blemishes
          • Easy to Use: The AirTag case with a carabiner clip allows for easy attachment to keys, bags, backpacks, or any desired item; The AirTag case with a 3M adhesive sticker provides a strong and secure mount on hard surfaces such as luggage, drones, and more
          • Package Contents: 2 Units of Pelican AirTag Case / Holder with Carabiner Clip + (2) Pelican AirTag Holder Sticker Mount - Protector Series Black (fits Apple AirTags only); One Year Limited Warranty; (Apple AirTag not included)

          Product Description

          It includes 2 Units of Pelican AirTag sticker mount and 2 Units of Pelican Airtag Case with carabiner clip. While the AirTag Sticker Mount comes with precise cutouts, 3M Adhesive, and a 2-piece design, the Air Tag Holder Keychain is made of heavy-duty materials, has a perfect fit for your Airtag, and comes with a carabiner clip to easily attach and detach your AirTag.


          Pelican AirTag Holder Features:

          • 4 Pack [2 units AirTag Stick-on Mount + 2 units AirTag Keychain]
          • Compatible with AirTags
          • 3M Adhesive
          • Detachable Carabiner Clips
          • Lightweight
          • Premium Material
          • Water-resistant Apple Airtag case
          • 1 Year Warranty


          Who are we: At Pelican, we have gained prestige among our buyers by protecting what matters the most, and we are now a leading supplier of rugged cases. We always strive to create products with the latest tech, premium materials, and extreme standards.

          We have a collection of defensive cases, waterproof cases, and screen protectors for recent flagships like the iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone Air, iPhone 17, S26 Series, Pixel 11 Pro XL, iPad, AirPods, and more.

          From the manufacturer

          Pelican Sticker Mount

          The Pelican Protector Stick-On Mount securely holds your AirTag in place with its carefully crafted 2-piece design. Easily stick the mount onto hard surfaces like bikes, electronics, athletic equipment, luggage and anything else you would like to keep track of.

          How customer reviews and ratings work

          Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

          To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
